[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. [Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. You find yourself floating in a vast, pitch black void...

A slow, musing presence enters your consciousness. You can feel it gently reaching out, feeling, examining you. It speaks in a calm and slow voice...
           
"Hmm... yes, what do we have here? Another lost soul drifting on the tides of the abyss, are you? How strange indeed that so many are trapped here... perhaps another catastrophic war? Or maybe the wrath of a particularly neglected divinity... they are rather temperamental, you know. But let us focus on you... perhaps you had a name at one point? What was it that others addressed you as?"

[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. Tucked away in a corner is an old door leading to a rundown store. The loud echoing of dripping water can be heard coming from a metal grate which is recessed into the street.

The area is illuminated.

[Combat Lounge]
The wooden walls of this room are covered with posters and pictures of figures in various combat positions. They exhibit a wide range of possible tactics that can be used with various weapons. A grizzled veteran, looking quite bored, leans against one of the walls and seems to be only interested in making sure the trainees fighting does not spill into the rest of the guild. A couple of couches are spread around the room to provide rest for those seeking to catch their breath, but a large sign on the northern wall indicates anyone with serious injuries should report to the healer across the central hall. An archway leads outside to the penned-in training area that are available to practice combat skills.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, wooden ladder, massive steel portcullis, stone stairs

w

[North Central Hall]
The central hallway of the Heroes Guild is decorated with portraits and busts of heroes of the Old Kingdom.  The pictures fill up nearly every inch of available wall space with distinguished-looking Human men and women. Along the walls darkened bronze sconces illuminate the portraits. Each portrait bears a bronze plaque with a name etched upon it, but years of neglect have rendered them tarnished and unreadable. From the east, are the faint cries and shouts of pitched combat, and, as if on cue, another young cadet rushes in and immediately out, heading west to the healer's room.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: west, south, east

s
s

[South Central Hall]
Down the entire length of the Central Guild hallway the walls are adorned with intricate portraits of recent Guild graduates. Upon first notice the portraits seem to be stationary, but as another eager student passes from the Guild an older image quickly morphs into the face of the new graduate. Between every portrait, gold hilted torches illuminate the eerily life-like illustrations, causing their newly polished nameplates to shine. A small wooden door on one side bears the sign: "Jeebz' Diskownt Markit."

The area is illuminated.

[Lounge]
Plush couches and armchairs are scattered around the room, arranged haphazardly into impromptu groupings. Around the room are small clusters of obviously flustered trainees, chatting amongst themselves about the examiners and various spell techniques. A small fireplace in the eastern wall both warms those near it and softly illuminates the hall, casting a comforting glow on everything in sight. To the left of the fireplace sits a door, a sign poorly nailed to the wall over it marking it as the trainers' housing. On the other side of the exit hangs a cork board dotted with messages written on scraps of faded paper in every language.

[Trainers Office]
This singular room is a hub of learning. It is lined with an array of doors, each leading into variously sized examination. Housed inside each of the small rooms is a teacher waiting to impart their knowledge upon trainees of all shapes and sizes. There is a simple pair of signs outside of each office, the first identifying the skill to be tested and the second explaining how one may practice the skill to improve if they have previously failed to advance a level. An iron staircase leads to an upper catwalk which provides access to other training areas in the building. Torches set along the walls in between the doors provide illumination across the room.

The area is illuminated.

[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. Tucked away in a corner is an old door leading to a rundown store. The loud echoing of dripping water can be heard coming from a metal grate which is recessed into the street.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, south, southeast, east, northeast, north, open grate, open off-center wooden door

The wooden walls of this room are covered with posters and pictures of figures in various combat positions. They exhibit a wide range of possible tactics that can be used with various weapons. A couple of couches are spread around the room to provide rest for those seeking to catch their breath, but a large sign on the northern wall indicates anyone with serious injuries should report to the healer across the central hall. The wooden walls of this room are covered with posters and pictures of figures in various combat positions. They exhibit a wide range of possible tactics that can be used with various weapons. A grizzled veteran, looking quite bored, leans against one of the walls and seems to be only interested in making sure the trainees fighting does not spill into the rest of the guild. A couple of couches are spread around the room to provide rest for those seeking to catch their breath, but a large sign on the northern wall indicates anyone with serious injuries should report to the healer across the central hall. An archway leads outside to the penned-in training area that are available to practice combat skills.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, wooden ladder, massive steel portcullis, stone stairs

go st

[Combat Training Area, Basement]
The stone stairs lead down to a dank and spacious area dimly lit by a series of lanterns hanging from the ceiling. The floor beneath you is damp and slick with slime, some of it coalescing in pools that glow with a faint, pulsing green light. It is difficult to tell... but some of the pools appear to be twitching.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: south, southeast, east, northeast, north, stone stairs

[Combat Training Area, Basement]
At the center of the basement, is a large pool of slime that bubbles and pops in steady intervals. Cadets stand by, readily firing bolts of flame and ice at slimes that emerge from the pool, many of them taking sport and enjoying themselves with slime shooting contests. At the center of the slime pool is a large metal pillar engraved with runes, magic coursing through it to give life to the slime pool below.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, southwest, south, southeast, east, northeast, north

Steam rises as the slime splashes against the cold stone floor, making things rather hazy.

[Combat Training Area, Basement]

With every shout or sound of battle from elsewhere in the basement, they quiver as if on alert, some scattering before returning carefully to their feeding. A disgusting stench envelopes the area, as the wood dissolves under the slimes, only slightly relieved by the vent in the ceiling.

The area is illuminated.

[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. Tucked away in a corner is an old door leading to a rundown store. The loud echoing of dripping water can be heard coming from a metal grate which is recessed into the street.

The area is illuminated.

Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. [Combat Lounge]
The wooden walls of this room are covered with posters and pictures of figures in various combat positions. They exhibit a wide range of possible tactics that can be used with various weapons. A grizzled veteran, looking quite bored, leans against one of the walls and seems to be only interested in making sure the trainees fighting does not spill into the rest of the guild. A couple of couches are spread around the room to provide rest for those seeking to catch their breath, but a large sign on the northern wall indicates anyone with serious injuries should report to the healer across the central hall. An archway leads outside to the penned-in training area that are available to practice combat skills.

The area is illuminated.
